title: Reverse String
description:
Write a function that reverses a string. The input string is given as an array of characters s.
You must do this by modifying the input array in-place with O(1) extra memory.
Example 1:
Example 2:
Constraints:
constraints: s[i] is a printable ascii character.
hints: The entire logic for reversing a string is based on using the opposite directional two-pointer approach!

func check(candidate func([]int, int) []int) {

    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate([]int{"a","b"}), nil)
    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate([]int{"a"}), nil)
    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate([]int{"A","b","C","d","E","f","G"}), nil)
    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate([]int{"A","b","C","d","E","f"}), nil)
    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate([]int{"Z"}), nil)
    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate([]int{"h","e","l","l","o"}), nil)
    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate([]int{"x","y","z","w","v","u","t","s","r","q","p"}), nil)
    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate([]int{"H","a","n","n","a","h"}), nil)
